description: Session index for each row. Join with session_protocol.csv.
Sample time within its session (t=0 is the start of that session's recording). NOT evenly spaced -- consecutive samples within a session have variable gaps.
Observed (noisy) membrane voltage at the corresponding time_ms.

The COMMANDED mean inter-sample interval for this session's acquisition. The ACTUAL sample-to-sample gaps vary around this mean -- see time_ms directly for the exact, irregular spacing realized in this session.
Number of samples recorded in this session.
Total recording duration for this session.
Coefficient of variation of the inter-sample interval distribution (same for every session).
'fit' = intended for parameter estimation. 'holdout' = reserved for validation; do not use these sessions when fitting model parameters.
